text:
alex: quick heads-up while testing onboarding sample-app: python SDK doesn't expose admin.rate_limits.list (AttributeError). docs only show curl.
rachel: what exact call?
alex: `client.admin.rate_limits.list(org_id=\"org_42\")` -> AttributeError. curl GET /v1/admin/rate-limits?org_id=org_42 returns payload.
tim: also noticed retry drift: server returns 429 with Retry-After but SDK RetryError doesn't surface the header so our backoff ignores it.
alex: small repro: from redwood import RedwoodClient; c=RedwoodClient(KEY); c.admin.rate_limits.list(org_id='org_42') -> RetryError logged with headers including "retry-after":"8" but exception object has no retry_after attr.
rachel: two issues then: missing binding in generated client + retry policy needs to parse Retry-After and attach to exception. I'll open a quick gen/regeneration PR.
bot-ci: Issue created DEVEX-4011 assigned to rachel.
tim: FYI payload field names drift: server uses `window_seconds` but python model maps to `window`. that mismatch broke the demo UI. we should preserve server keys or add aliases.
alex: patching sample-app to accept both names short-term. add unit test for 429+Retry-After once PR lands.
rachel: I'll regen SDKs for python and typescript, add parity checklist in PR, include changelog note about `window_seconds` -> `window`, and ping #release-war-room for pinned Dedicated customers.
tim: thanks, please post follow-up when merged so we can update onboarding env.
